extDescription.message: Velocity badges, long-image reader, Markdown copy, supporter chart, and Grok reply drafts — all on X. No data collection.

popupSubtitle.message: Real-time impression velocity on X tweets

hoverHint.message: Hover badges to see views, likes, RT, replies, bookmarks and viral score.

featureCopyMdDesc.message: Adds a "Copy as Markdown" entry at the bottom of X's native share menu. Copies the tweet text, author, link and date in Markdown format.

featureLeaderboardDesc.message: Draggable floating panel showing the fastest-growing tweets visible on the current page. Click a row to scroll to the tweet.

featureLeaderboardEdgeHideDesc.message: When enabled, drag the leaderboard to a screen edge and release to tuck it away.

featureLeaderboardColsHint.message: Drag to reorder · check to show

popupStarChartHint.message: Adds a star-chart option to the share menu of any tweet.

featureBookmarkFoldersDesc.message: Hover over a tweet bookmark button to pick a folder, see where it is saved, or create a folder. Requires X Premium.

contentBookmarkMenuCheckFailed.message: Couldn’t check current folder. Click a folder to retry.

communityDevSub.message: All local Pro features are enabled. Official license service and auto-updates belong to the Web Store build.

heroFreeTagline.message: Most features are free. A few advanced extras are Pro.

proScopeBody.message: Pro covers a small set of advanced extras. Today it mainly powers velocity filtering; the exact paid scope may change by version, so the website has the latest details.

proFreeBody.message: Velocity badges, leaderboard, bookmark counts, long-image reading, image enhancements, content filter, Grok helper, Markdown copy, and bookmark-folder tools remain free to use.

popupGrokEnterReplyHint.message: When enabled, plain Enter sends the reply. Shift/Command/Ctrl/Alt+Enter keep their original behavior.

contentLbHotProTitle.message: Velocity filter is a Pro feature

contentLbHotProSub.message: Hide low-views tweets, keep what's actually spreading

contentLbHotEnabledToast.message: Hot only is on: posts that do not meet the hot-post threshold will be removed from this page.

contentLbHotActiveNotice.message: Hot only is on. Posts below the threshold are hidden.

contentUpdateTitle.message: X Viral Monitor has been updated

contentUpdateSubtitle.message: A few useful changes in this update are easy to miss:

contentUpdateItemAiProviderBody.message: Open Settings → AI comment generation to choose X Grok, OpenAI-compatible providers, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or local Ollama.

contentUpdateItemReplyToolsBody.message: Added an option to send comments with Enter. Enable it in Settings → Other features → Press Enter to reply, then you no longer need Command + Enter in reply boxes.

contentUpdateItemHotOnlyBody.message: When Hot only is enabled, posts below the threshold are removed from the page. You can choose where it applies in the Popup or floating panel settings.

contentUpdateItemBookmarkToolsTitle.message: Bookmark tools are easier to find

contentUpdateItemBookmarkToolsBody.message: In Settings → Other features, enable the bookmark folder menu and bookmark counts to pick save folders, see saved locations, and show bookmark counts on the timeline.

contentUpdateItemFilterRulesBody.message: Content filtering now avoids more false positives around normal Telegram mentions, while catching additional WeChat / Telegram funnel patterns in replies and profile bios.

cfLockedHint.message: Content filtering is free. You can enable it here.

cfScopeHint.message: Only applies to reply areas on tweet detail pages. Home, search, profiles, and the main tweet are not filtered.

cfRuleHint.message: Rules run locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded. Whitelist runs first, then hard rules and severity thresholds.
